directional_followup_scope: Same two V194 examples and native recipe normals; eight future new projections with independent spatial checks. Metadata preparation corrected abbreviated context labels in separate v2 before any calculation; original v1 plan/source retained.
controller_scope: Wait on the actual original owners, then run frozen CPU training audit, one four-endpoint quality job, CPU quality audit, reduction and rendering. Stop for actual native viewing; no automatic publication or worker restart.

"""All822 cases for each V195 endpoint, with exact inherited baseline replay."""

import argparse
import gc
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from directional_trial_protocol import (
    MODES,
    factory,
    freeze,
    guard,
    read,
    ref,
    require_launch,
    save,
)
from directional_trial_protocol import (
    TRIAL as ROOT,
)
from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live


def source_guard(plan):
    guard(plan)
    seal = read(ROOT / "review-source-v1.json")
    for name, digest in seal["frozen_files"].items():
        assert ref(name)["sha256"] == digest
    return seal


def ready(plan):
    for mode in MODES:
        owner = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-launch-v1.json")["owner"]
        assert not owner_live(owner)
        assert not (ROOT / f"{mode}-train-failure-v1.json").exists()
        result = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-train-result-v1.json")
        assert result["owner"] == owner and result["status"].startswith("completed-V195-")
    audit = read(ROOT / "training-audit-v1.json")
    assert (
        audit["status"] == "pass-V195-two-matched-traces-ten-checkpoints-Adam-EMA-and-inherited189"
    )
    assert audit["plan"] == ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")


def prepare():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    assert not (ROOT / "review-source-v1.json").exists()
    work, sources = freeze(
        ROOT / "review-frozen-v1",
        [
            "review_directional_response.py",
            "audit_directional_quality.py",
            "render_directional_response.py",
            "reduce_directional_response.py",
        ],
    )
    save(
        ROOT / "review-source-v1.json",
        {
            "created_unix_UTC": time.time(),
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "work": str(work),
            "reviewer": ref(work / "scripts/review_directional_response.py"),
            "auditor": ref(work / "scripts/audit_directional_quality.py"),
            "renderer": ref(work / "scripts/render_directional_response.py"),
            "reducer": ref(work / "scripts/reduce_directional_response.py"),
            "frozen_files": sources,
            "scope": "Prepare code while training may run; review requires both original owners terminal and full CPU training audit. Four endpoints x822cases,144native RGB+144wave encodings,exact V183/V169 replays,all protected scenes. Reuse inputs/baselines; compact six-method current figures/tables instead of recopying historical galleries. No quality claim at preparation.",
        },
    )
    print("Prepared four-endpoint review; training completion/audit required before launch")


def review():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    seal = source_guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == seal["reviewer"]
    ready(plan)
    owner = require_launch(ROOT, "review")
    (ROOT / "review.claim").open("x").close()
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from balanced_spatial_metrics import DetailMetrics, summarize
    from lossless_native import write_native
    from phase_wave_training_state import inherited_hash, load_ema
    from pooled_wave_evidence_receipt import describe_pooled, describe_support
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from spatial_trial_protocol import open_text
    from spatial_wave_training_state import expand_checkpoint
    from train_coherent_pair_evidence_engine import instrument
    from train_directional_response import common_engine

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    common = common_engine()
    common.runtime(plan)
    baseline_scores = read(plan["baseline_scores"]["path"])
    baseline_method = "V183-coherent-pair-EMA"
    baseline = {r["id"]: r for r in baseline_scores["rows"] if r["method"] == baseline_method}
    frozen = {
        r["id"]: r
        for r in read(plan["prior_scores"]["path"])["rows"]
        if r["method"] == "balanced-EMA"
    }
    assert len(baseline) == len(frozen) == 822
    metric = DetailMetrics(plan["metrics_sources"])
    design = read(plan["design"]["path"])["observations"]
    counts = dict.fromkeys(["wrapper", "frozen", "network", "sampler", "projection"], 0)
    head_calls = {"calls": 0}
    rows, native, hashes, checkpoints = [], {}, {}, {}
    ADC = closure_channels = 0
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    with (
        (ROOT / "quality-events-v1.jsonl").open("x") as events,
        open_text(ROOT / "quality-observations-v1.jsonl.gz", "xt") as journal,
    ):
        for mode in MODES:
            training = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-train-result-v1.json")
            checkpoint = training["final_checkpoint"]
            assert ref(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint
            checkpoints[mode] = checkpoint
            state = expand_checkpoint(
                torch.load(checkpoint["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            )
            for endpoint, method in plan["methods"][mode].items():
                module = instrument(factory(plan["module_config"]).cuda(), counts).eval()
                module.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
                if endpoint == "EMA":
                    load_ema(module, state["ema"])
                assert inherited_hash(module) == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
                before = model_hash(module)
                module.wave_readout.register_forward_pre_hook(
                    lambda *args: head_calls.__setitem__("calls", head_calls["calls"] + 1)
                )
                hashes[method] = {
                    "before": before,
                    "inherited": inherited_hash(module),
                    "frozen": model_hash(module.frozen),
                }
                for ordinal, index in enumerate(plan["processing_order"]):
                    common.resources(plan, "review", owner)
                    case = design[index]
                    assert (
                        ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
                        and ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
                    )
                    arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
                    base = np.load(case["parent"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)
                    batch = {
                        k: torch.from_numpy(arrays[k]).cuda()
                        for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]
                    }
                    with torch.inference_mode():
                        output, aux = module(
                            torch.from_numpy(base).cuda(),
                            *(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]),
                            return_aux=True,
                        )
                    value = output.cpu().numpy()
                    inherited = aux["inherited_output"].cpu().numpy()
                    v169 = aux["frozen_output"].cpu().numpy()
                    wave = aux["wave_correction"].cpu().numpy()
                    assert fingerprint(inherited) == baseline[case["id"]]["values"]
                    assert fingerprint(v169) == frozen[case["id"]]["values"]
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(value, inherited + wave)
                    closure_channels += value.size
                    if not aux["matching_evaluated"]:
                        assert np.array_equal(value, v169) and not np.any(wave)
                        assert not np.any(arrays["variance"])
                        ADC += 1
                    row = metric.measure(case, arrays, base, value)
                    row.update(
                        method=method,
                        index=index,
                        values=fingerprint(value),
                        inherited_values=fingerprint(inherited),
                        frozen_values=fingerprint(v169),
                        inherited_V183_EMA_replay_exact=True,
                        frozen_V169_replay_exact=True,
                        ADC_exact=not aux["matching_evaluated"],
                        wave_correction_values=fingerprint(wave),
                        wave_correction_RMS_DN16=float(
                            np.sqrt(np.mean(wave.astype(np.float64) ** 2))
                        )
                        * 65535,
                    )
                    if case["id"] in plan["native_cases"]:
                        directory = Path(plan["artifacts"]) / "native"
                        delta = write_native(
                            directory / f"{method}-wave-{index:03d}.native.json", wave
                        )
                        encoded = write_native(
                            directory / f"{method}-{index:03d}.native.json",
                            value,
                            baseline=baseline_scores["native_predictions"][case["id"]][
                                baseline_method
                            ],
                            wave=delta,
                        )
                        native.setdefault(case["id"], {}).update(
                            {method: encoded, method + "-wave": delta}
                        )
                        row["prediction"] = encoded
                    rows.append(row)
                    evidence = (
                        None
                        if aux["phase_evidence"] is None
                        else {
                            k: v.detach().cpu().tolist() for k, v in aux["phase_evidence"].items()
                        }
                    )
                    journal.write(
                        json.dumps(
                            {
                                "method": method,
                                "index": index,
                                "id": case["id"],
                                "arrays": case["arrays"],
                                "parent": case["parent"],
                                "inputs": {k: fingerprint(arrays[k]) for k in batch},
                                "row": row,
                                "evidence": evidence,
                                "support": describe_support(aux),
                                "pooled": describe_pooled(aux),
                                "inherited_replay_exact": True,
                                "frozen_replay_exact": True,
                                "baseline_plus_wave_closure_exact": True,
                            },
                            allow_nan=False,
                        )
                        + "\n"
                    )
                    journal.flush()
                    events.write(
                        json.dumps(
                            {
                                "method": method,
                                "index": index,
                                "ordinal": ordinal,
                                "id": case["id"],
                                "counts": dict(counts),
                                "readout_calls": head_calls["calls"],
                                "matching_evaluated": aux["matching_evaluated"],
                            }
                        )
                        + "\n"
                    )
                    events.flush()
                    if ordinal % 16 == 0:
                        common.progress(
                            "review",
                            {
                                "status": "reviewing",
                                "owner": owner,
                                "method": method,
                                "ordinal": ordinal,
                                "index": index,
                                "counts": dict(counts),
                                "readout_calls": head_calls["calls"],
                                "peak_CUDA_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                            },
                        )
                    del arrays, base, batch, output, aux, value, inherited, v169, wave, evidence
                assert (
                    model_hash(module) == before
                    and inherited_hash(module) == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
                )
                hashes[method]["after"] = model_hash(module)
                del module
                gc.collect()
            del state
    assert counts == plan["expected_quality_counts"] and head_calls["calls"] == 3000
    assert len(rows) == 3288 and len(native) == 36 and ADC == 288
    assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
        cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
    )
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["index"], r["method"]))
    source_guard(plan)
    save(
        ROOT / "scores-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-V195-four-endpoint-quality-awaiting-native-viewing",
            "owner": owner,
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "checkpoints": checkpoints,
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summarize(rows),
            "counts": counts,
            "readout_calls": 3000,
            "native_predictions": native,
            "module_hashes": hashes,
            "weights_unchanged": True,
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "exact_V183_EMA_replays": 3288,
            "exact_V169_replays": 3288,
            "ADC_outputs_exact_V169": ADC,
            "independent_inprocess_baseline_plus_wave_addition_channels": closure_channels,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
            "peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    common.progress(
        "review",
        {"status": "completed-quality-awaiting-native-viewing", "owner": owner, "counts": counts},
    )
    print(
        "Completed 4x822cases / inherited replays /144native RGB+144wave; actual viewing pending",
        flush=True,
    )


def launch_review():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    seal = source_guard(plan)
    ready(plan)
    # The shared launcher binds a runner; leave the original training plan intact.
    import os
    import subprocess

    import psutil

    assert not (ROOT / "review-launch-v1.json").exists()
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > plan["launch_RAM_GiB"] * 2**30
    env = dict(
        os.environ,
        PYTHONPATH=f"{seal['work']}/src:{seal['work']}/scripts",
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
        OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
        MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
        CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
    )
    from directional_trial_protocol import REPO

    with (ROOT / "review-v1.log").open("xb") as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"), seal["reviewer"]["path"], "review"],
            cwd=REPO,
            env=env,
            stdout=log,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            start_new_session=True,
        )
    owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
    save(
        ROOT / "review-launch-v1.json",
        {
            "owner": owner,
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "review_source": ref(ROOT / "review-source-v1.json"),
        },
    )
    print(owner)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["prepare", "launch", "review"])
    phase = parser.parse_args().phase
    if phase == "prepare":
        prepare()
    elif phase == "launch":
        launch_review()
    else:
        try:
            review()
        except BaseException as exc:
            save(ROOT / "review-failure-v1.json", {"error": repr(exc), "time_UTC": time.time()})
            raise

"""Independent four-endpoint V195 stream, native RGB/wave, and strict-state audit."""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from audit_coherent_pair_evidence_trial import validate_evidence, validate_summary
from directional_trial_protocol import MODES, factory, guard, save
from directional_trial_protocol import TRIAL as ROOT
from lossless_native import load_native
from pooled_wave_evidence_receipt import validate_pooled, validate_support
from review_directional_response import source_guard
from spatial_trial_protocol import open_text, owner_live, read, ref


def fingerprint(value):
    return {
        "shape": list(value.shape),
        "dtype": value.dtype.str,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(value).tobytes()).hexdigest(),
    }


def native_addition(value, inherited, wave):
    if any(
        v.dtype != np.float32 or v.ndim != 4 or v.shape[1] != 3 or not np.isfinite(v).all()
        for v in [value, inherited, wave]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected finite native FP32 RGB and wave arrays")
    assert value.shape == inherited.shape == wave.shape
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(value, inherited + wave)
    return value.size


def validate_stream(plan, scores, design, events, journal, inputs, baseline, frozen):
    methods = [method for mode in MODES for method in plan["methods"][mode].values()]
    order = plan["processing_order"]
    assert len(events) == len(journal) == len(scores["rows"]) == len(methods) * len(design)
    scored = {(r["id"], r["method"]): r for r in scores["rows"]}
    assert len(scored) == len(scores["rows"])
    counts = dict.fromkeys(["wrapper", "frozen", "network", "sampler", "projection"], 0)
    head_calls = ADC = bindings = 0
    evidence = {}
    support = {}
    pooled = {}
    for position, (event, record) in enumerate(zip(events, journal, strict=True)):
        endpoint, ordinal = divmod(position, len(order))
        index = order[ordinal]
        case = design[index]
        method = methods[endpoint]
        data = inputs[case["id"]]
        noisy = data["noisy"]
        row = scored[case["id"], method]
        assert event["index"] == record["index"] == row["index"] == index
        assert event["method"] == record["method"] == row["method"] == method
        assert (
            event["id"] == record["id"] == row["id"] == case["id"] and event["ordinal"] == ordinal
        )
        assert record["arrays"] == case["arrays"] and record["parent"] == case["parent"]
        assert record["inputs"] == data["fingerprints"]
        bindings += 4
        assert record["row"] == row and event["matching_evaluated"] == noisy
        assert (
            row["inherited_values"] == baseline[case["id"]]["values"]
            and row["frozen_values"] == frozen[case["id"]]["values"]
        )
        assert row["inherited_V183_EMA_replay_exact"] and row["frozen_V169_replay_exact"]
        assert (
            record["inherited_replay_exact"]
            and record["frozen_replay_exact"]
            and record["baseline_plus_wave_closure_exact"]
        )
        assert row["ADC_exact"] == (not noisy)
        if not noisy:
            assert row["values"] == row["inherited_values"] == row["frozen_values"]
            assert row["wave_correction_RMS_DN16"] == 0
            ADC += 1
        for key in counts:
            counts[key] += (
                5 * int(noisy)
                if key == "sampler"
                else (1 if key in ["wrapper", "frozen"] else int(noisy))
            )
        head_calls += int(noisy)
        assert event["counts"] == counts and event["readout_calls"] == head_calls
        if noisy:
            validate_evidence(
                record["evidence"], data["packed_shape"], data["colors"], plan["module_config"]
            )
            validate_support(
                record["support"],
                data["packed_shape"],
                record["pooled"]["selection"],
                plan["module_config"],
            )
            validate_pooled(
                record["pooled"], data["packed_shape"], data["colors"], plan["module_config"]
            )
            if case["id"] in pooled:
                assert record["pooled"] == pooled[case["id"]]
            else:
                pooled[case["id"]] = record["pooled"]
            if case["id"] in support:
                assert record["support"] == support[case["id"]]
            else:
                support[case["id"]] = record["support"]
            if case["id"] in evidence:
                assert record["evidence"] == evidence[case["id"]]
            else:
                evidence[case["id"]] = record["evidence"]
        else:
            assert record["evidence"] is record["support"] is record["pooled"] is None
    assert counts == scores["counts"] == plan["expected_quality_counts"]
    assert (
        head_calls == scores["readout_calls"] == 3000
        and ADC == scores["ADC_outputs_exact_V169"] == 288
    )
    assert scores["exact_V183_EMA_replays"] == scores["exact_V169_replays"] == len(journal)
    assert scores["weights_unchanged"] and scores["RNG_unchanged"]
    return {
        "events": len(events),
        "input_fingerprints": bindings,
        "counts": counts,
        "readout_calls": head_calls,
        "V183_EMA_replay_bindings": len(events),
        "V169_replay_bindings": len(events),
        "ADC_outputs": ADC,
        "exact_input_only_four_endpoint_evidence_groups": len(evidence),
        "exact_input_only_four_endpoint_support_groups": len(support),
        "exact_input_only_four_endpoint_pooled_selection_wave_groups": len(pooled),
    }


def audit():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    seal = source_guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == seal["auditor"] and seal["plan"] == ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    METHODS = {
        (mode, endpoint): method
        for mode in MODES
        for endpoint, method in plan["methods"][mode].items()
    }
    launch = read(ROOT / "review-launch-v1.json")
    if owner_live(launch["owner"]):
        raise RuntimeError("Actual review is still live; no Torch import")
    assert not (ROOT / "review-failure-v1.json").exists()
    scores = read(ROOT / "scores-v1.json")
    assert (
        scores["owner"] == launch["owner"]
        and scores["status"] == "completed-V195-four-endpoint-quality-awaiting-native-viewing"
    )
    assert scores["plan"] == ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    assert not (ROOT / "quality-audit-v1.json").exists()
    import torch
    from balanced_spatial_metrics import DetailMetrics
    from phase_wave_training_state import inherited_hash, load_ema
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from spatial_wave_training_state import expand_checkpoint

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    baseline_scores = read(plan["baseline_scores"]["path"])
    baseline = {
        r["id"]: r for r in baseline_scores["rows"] if r["method"] == "V183-coherent-pair-EMA"
    }
    frozen = {
        r["id"]: r
        for r in read(plan["prior_scores"]["path"])["rows"]
        if r["method"] == "balanced-EMA"
    }
    design = read(plan["design"]["path"])["observations"]
    metric = DetailMetrics(plan["metrics_sources"])
    rows = {(r["id"], r["method"]): r for r in scores["rows"]}
    assert len(baseline) == len(frozen) == len(design) == 822
    assert sorted(plan["processing_order"]) == list(range(822))
    inputs = {}
    channels = predictions = waves = scalars = wave_scalars = 0
    for index in plan["processing_order"]:
        case = design[index]
        assert (
            ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
            and ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
        )
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
        base = np.load(case["parent"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)
        inputs[case["id"]] = {
            "noisy": bool(np.any(arrays["variance"] > 0)),
            "fingerprints": {
                k: fingerprint(arrays[k]) for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]
            },
            "packed_shape": arrays["packed"].shape,
            "colors": arrays["colors"].tolist(),
        }
        if case["id"] not in plan["native_cases"]:
            continue
        bindings = scores["native_predictions"][case["id"]]
        assert set(bindings) == set(METHODS.values()) | {m + "-wave" for m in METHODS.values()}
        inherited_binding = baseline_scores["native_predictions"][case["id"]][
            "V183-coherent-pair-EMA"
        ]
        assert ref(inherited_binding["path"]) == inherited_binding
        inherited = np.load(inherited_binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)
        assert fingerprint(inherited) == baseline[case["id"]]["values"]
        for method in METHODS.values():
            row = rows[case["id"], method]
            for key in [method, method + "-wave"]:
                assert ref(bindings[key]["path"]) == bindings[key]
            value = load_native(bindings[method])
            wave = load_native(bindings[method + "-wave"])
            assert (
                fingerprint(value) == row["values"]
                and fingerprint(wave) == row["wave_correction_values"]
            )
            assert row["prediction"] == bindings[method]
            channels += native_addition(value, inherited, wave)
            predictions += 1
            waves += 1
            rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(wave.astype(np.float64) ** 2))) * 65535
            assert abs(rms - row["wave_correction_RMS_DN16"]) < 1e-10
            wave_scalars += 1
            if not inputs[case["id"]]["noisy"]:
                assert not np.any(wave) and np.array_equal(value, inherited)
            measured = metric.measure(case, arrays, base, value)
            for field, observed in measured.items():
                if isinstance(observed, (float, int)) and not isinstance(observed, bool):
                    assert abs(observed - row[field]) < 1e-10
                    scalars += 1
                else:
                    assert observed == row[field]
    event_path, journal_path = (
        ROOT / "quality-events-v1.jsonl",
        ROOT / "quality-observations-v1.jsonl.gz",
    )
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in event_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    with open_text(journal_path) as stream:
        journal = [json.loads(line) for line in stream]
    stream = validate_stream(plan, scores, design, events, journal, inputs, baseline, frozen)
    means = validate_summary(scores["rows"], scores["summary"])
    initial = torch.load(
        plan["initializer"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
    )
    hashes = {}
    for mode in MODES:
        training = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-train-result-v1.json")
        checkpoint = scores["checkpoints"][mode]
        assert checkpoint == training["final_checkpoint"] and ref(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint
        state = expand_checkpoint(
            torch.load(checkpoint["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        )
        for endpoint, method in plan["methods"][mode].items():
            module = factory(plan["module_config"])
            module.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
            if endpoint == "EMA":
                load_ema(module, state["ema"])
            assert all(
                torch.equal(module.state_dict()[n], v) for n, v in initial["state_dict"].items()
            )
            assert inherited_hash(module) == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
            expected = scores["module_hashes"][method]
            assert expected["inherited"] == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
            assert (
                model_hash(module.frozen)
                == expected["frozen"]
                == plan["frozen_component"]["module_hash"]
            )
            assert model_hash(module) == expected["before"] == expected["after"]
            hashes[method] = model_hash(module)
    assert predictions == waves == 144 and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    save(
        ROOT / "quality-audit-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "pass-V195-four-endpoint-inputs-inherited-replays-native-additions-and-EMA",
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(ROOT / "scores-v1.json"),
            "stream": stream,
            "native_RGB_arrays": predictions,
            "native_wave_arrays": waves,
            "independent_native_baseline_plus_wave_channels": channels,
            "native_metric_scalars_recomputed": scalars,
            "native_wave_RMS_scalars_recomputed": wave_scalars,
            "independent_Decimal_summary_means": means,
            "endpoint_hashes": hashes,
            "inherited_tensor_comparisons": 756,
            "forward_journal": ref(event_path),
            "observation_journal": ref(journal_path),
            "actual_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_sensor_source_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_initialized": False,
            "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        },
    )
    print(
        "PASS3288rows/6576inheritedReplayBindings/144RGB+144wave/",

        "nativeAdditionChannels/",
        means,
        "means",
    )

"""Compact native V195 boards: one current baseline, four endpoints and references."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from directional_trial_protocol import MODES, read, ref, save
from directional_trial_protocol import TRIAL as ROOT
from lossless_native import load_native
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from review_directional_response import source_guard


def render():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    seal = source_guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == seal["renderer"]
    assert read(ROOT / "quality-audit-v1.json")["status"].startswith("pass-V195-four-endpoint")
    scores = read(ROOT / "scores-v1.json")
    prior_path = Path(plan["V187_plan"]["path"]).parent / "figures-v1.json"
    prior = read(prior_path)
    prior_scores = read(plan["V187_scores"]["path"])
    methods = [method for mode in MODES for method in plan["methods"][mode].values()]
    out = ROOT / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir()
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    figures = []
    displayed_channels = copied_channels = 0

    def board(old, selections):
        nonlocal displayed_channels, copied_channels
        assert ref(old["image"]["path"]) == old["image"]
        source = np.asarray(Image.open(old["image"]["path"]))
        case = old["case"]
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
        anchor = np.asarray(old["anchor"], dtype=np.float64).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(selections), 212), "#eeeeee")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
        draw.text(
            (8, 4),
            f"{case['id']} | native160px, contrast{old['contrast']:g}, exposure{old['exposure']:g}",
            font=font,
            fill="black",
        )
        panels, bindings = [], {}
        for column, selection in enumerate(selections):
            x = 8 + 168 * column
            if isinstance(selection, str):
                label = selection
                binding = (
                    prior_scores["native_predictions"][case["id"]][selection]
                    if selection == "V187-pooled-wave-EMA"
                    else scores["native_predictions"][case["id"]][selection]
                )
                value = load_native(binding)
                displayed = anchor + old["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                crop = pixels(displayed, arrays, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                    crop, independent_display(displayed, arrays, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                )
                bindings[selection] = binding
                displayed_channels += crop.size
                provenance = {"prediction": binding}
            else:
                label = selection["label"]
                sx, sy, w, h = selection["xywh"]
                assert w == h == 160
                crop = source[sy : sy + h, sx : sx + w].copy()
                copied_channels += crop.size
                provenance = {"source_figure": old["image"], "source_xywh": selection["xywh"]}
                if label == "Exact constructed GT":
                    target = anchor + old["contrast"] * (
                        arrays["target"].astype(np.float64) - anchor
                    )
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                        crop, pixels(target, arrays, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    )
            assert crop.shape == (160, 160, 3) and crop.dtype == np.uint8
            short = (
                label.replace("V195-whole-response-", "Whole ")
                .replace("V195-directional-response-", "Directional ")
                .replace("V187-pooled-wave-", "V187 ")
            )
            draw.text((x, 26), short, font=font, fill="black")
            canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(crop), (x, 44))
            panels.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x, 44, 160, 160], **provenance})
        path = out / f"comparison-{len(figures):02d}.png"
        canvas.save(path)
        image = np.asarray(Image.open(path))
        for panel in panels:
            x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
            if "source_figure" in panel:
                sx, sy, _, _ = panel["source_xywh"]
                expected = source[sy : sy + h, sx : sx + w]
            else:
                value = load_native(panel["prediction"])
                displayed = anchor + old["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                expected = independent_display(displayed, arrays, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y : y + h, x : x + w], expected)
        figures.append(
            {
                "case": case,
                "ROI_xywh": old["ROI_xywh"],
                "anchor": old["anchor"],
                "contrast": old["contrast"],
                "exposure": old["exposure"],
                "image": ref(path),
                "panels": panels,
                "predictions": bindings,
                "source_figure": old["image"],
                "triplet": len(selections) == 3,
                "no_resize": True,
                "checkpoints": {mode: scores["checkpoints"][mode] for mode in MODES},
                "reference_role": case["reference_role"],
            }
        )

    for old in prior["images"]:
        if old["triplet"]:
            # One old EMA triplet per source/transform; make four new triplets.
            if old["panels"][1]["label"] != "V187-pooled-wave-EMA":
                continue
            for method in methods:
                board(old, [old["panels"][0], method, old["panels"][-1]])
        else:
            references = [
                p
                for p in old["panels"]
                if p["label"] == "Exact constructed GT" or p["label"].startswith("ISO")
            ]
            assert references
            board(old, [old["panels"][0], "V187-pooled-wave-EMA", *methods, *references])
    assert len(figures) == 72 and sum(f["triplet"] for f in figures) == 24
    sheets = []
    for start in range(0, len(figures), 4):
        group = figures[start : start + 4]
        canvas = Image.new(
            "RGB",
            (max(Image.open(f["image"]["path"]).width for f in group), 212 * len(group)),
            "#eeeeee",
        )
        for row, item in enumerate(group):
            canvas.paste(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]), (0, 212 * row))
        path = out / f"sheet-{len(sheets):02d}.png"
        canvas.save(path)
        sheets.append(
            {
                "indices": list(range(start, start + len(group))),
                "image": ref(path),
                "no_resize": True,
            }
        )
    save(
        ROOT / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-V195-compact-native-comparisons-awaiting-actual-viewing",
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(ROOT / "scores-v1.json"),
            "prior_figures": ref(prior_path),
            "images": figures,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "native_figures": 72,
            "native_triplets": 24,
            "no_resize": True,
            "RGB_channels_independently_displayed": displayed_channels,
            "verified_earlier_noisy_reference_channels_copied": copied_channels,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
            "renderer": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        },
    )
    print("Rendered 48 compact boards +24 native triplets; actual viewing pending")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    render()

reduce_directional_response.py.text:
"""Compact current-baseline comparisons for V195, retaining source score bindings."""

import math
from collections import defaultdict

from audit_coherent_pair_evidence_trial import validate_summary
from balanced_spatial_metrics import summarize
from directional_trial_protocol import MODES, read, ref
from directional_trial_protocol import TRIAL as ROOT
from review_directional_response import source_guard
from spatial_trial_protocol import save


def condition(row):
    return row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise")))


def numeric(value):
    return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value)


def reduce():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    seal = source_guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == seal["reducer"]
    assert read(ROOT / "quality-audit-v1.json")["status"].startswith("pass-V195-four-endpoint")
    scores = read(ROOT / "scores-v1.json")
    rows = list(scores["rows"])
    sources = []
    for key, method in [
        ("baseline_scores", "V183-coherent-pair-EMA"),
        ("V187_scores", "V187-pooled-wave-EMA"),
    ]:
        binding = plan[key]
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        old = read(binding["path"])
        previous = read(old["plan"]["path"])
        assert (
            previous["design"] == plan["design"]
            and previous["metrics_sources"] == plan["metrics_sources"]
        )
        selected = [r for r in old["rows"] if r["method"] == method]
        assert len(selected) == 822
        rows += selected
        sources.append({"scores": binding, "method": method})
    methods = ["V183-coherent-pair-EMA", "V187-pooled-wave-EMA"] + [
        m for mode in MODES for m in plan["methods"][mode].values()
    ]
    by_id = {(r["id"], r["method"]): r for r in rows}
    assert len(rows) == len(by_id) == 4932
    summary = summarize(rows)
    decimal_checks = validate_summary(rows, summary)
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[row["kind"], condition(row), row.get("cohort"), row["method"]].append(row)
    contrasts = [
        (
            plan["methods"]["directional"][endpoint],
            plan["methods"]["whole"][endpoint],
            "matched-response-" + endpoint,
        )
        for endpoint in ["raw", "EMA"]
    ]
    contrasts += [
        (m, "V187-pooled-wave-EMA", "shared-donor")
        for mode in MODES
        for m in plan["methods"][mode].values()
    ]
    paired = []
    for candidate, baseline, role in contrasts:
        for (kind, state, cohort, method), group in groups.items():
            if method != candidate or kind == "real":
                continue
            for field in group[0]:
                if not field.endswith(("DN16", "gain", "error")):
                    continue
                if not all(
                    numeric(r.get(field)) and numeric(by_id[r["id"], baseline].get(field))
                    for r in group
                ):
                    continue
                values = [
                    {
                        "id": r["id"],
                        "candidate": r[field],
                        "baseline": by_id[r["id"], baseline][field],
                        "difference": r[field] - by_id[r["id"], baseline][field],
                    }
                    for r in group
                ]
                a, b = [
                    math.fsum(v[k] for v in values) / len(values) for k in ["candidate", "baseline"]
                ]
                diffs = [v["difference"] for v in values]
                signed_gain = field.endswith("gain") and not (kind == "mesh" and state is True)
                paired.append(
                    {
                        "candidate": candidate,
                        "baseline": baseline,
                        "role": role,
                        "kind": kind,
                        "condition": state,
                        "cohort": cohort,
                        "field": field,
                        "cases": len(group),
                        "candidate_mean": a,
                        "baseline_mean": b,
                        "mean_difference": math.fsum(diffs) / len(diffs),
                        "relative_mean_percent": None
                        if signed_gain or b <= 0
                        else 100 * (a - b) / b,
                        "positive": sum(d > 0 for d in diffs),
                        "negative": sum(d < 0 for d in diffs),
                        "equal": sum(d == 0 for d in diffs),
                        "values": values,
                    }
                )
    table = []
    dimensions = {(r["kind"], condition(r), r.get("cohort")) for r in rows if r["kind"] != "real"}
    for kind, state, cohort in sorted(dimensions, key=repr):
        summary_group = {
            r["method"]: r
            for r in summary
            if (r["kind"], r["condition"], r["cohort"]) == (kind, state, cohort)
        }
        common = set.intersection(*(set(r) for r in summary_group.values()))
        for field in sorted(common):
            if field.endswith(("DN16", "gain", "error")) and all(
                numeric(summary_group[m][field]) for m in methods
            ):
                table.append(
                    {
                        "kind": kind,
                        "condition": state,
                        "cohort": cohort,
                        "field": field,
                        "cases": summary_group[methods[0]]["cases"],
                        "values": {m: summary_group[m][field] for m in methods},
                    }
                )
    save(
        ROOT / "paired-comparisons-v1.json.gz",
        {
            "status": "completed-V195-six-current-method-compact-comparison",
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(ROOT / "scores-v1.json"),
            "source_scores": sources,
            "methods": methods,
            "metric_rows": len(rows),
            "summary": summary,
            "independent_Decimal_summary_checks": decimal_checks,
            "contrasts": paired,
            "table_rows": table,
            "real_references_scored": False,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": "Two primary same-state directional/whole contrasts, four shared V187 EMA donor contrasts. V183 EMA aggregate context. All historical scores/reports/viewers preserved at their existing paths; no recopy of all historical columns. Signed/absent gains use absolute differences, not misleading relative percentages.",
        },
    )
    print(
        "Reduced",
        len(rows),
        "rows /",
        len(table),
        "table rows /",
        len(paired),
        "paired metric groups",
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    reduce()

"""Repeat the pre-existing two-example V194 diagnostic on V195 saved predictions."""

import argparse
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from audit_mesh_orientation_response import reference
from directional_trial_protocol import MODES, REPO, TRIAL, freeze, guard, read, ref, save
from lossless_native import load_native
from mesh_orientation_response import project
from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live

ROOT = TRIAL / "directional-breakdown-v2"
PREVIOUS = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261108/V194-orientation-response-v1"


def prepare():
    plan = read(TRIAL / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    old = read(PREVIOUS / "plan-v2.json")
    assert not ROOT.exists()
    ROOT.mkdir()
    work, sources = freeze(ROOT, ["directional_quality_breakdown.py"])
    prepared = {
        "status": "prepared-same-two-directional-examples-four-new-endpoints-no-quality-yet",
        "created_unix_UTC": time.time(),
        "runner": ref(work / "scripts/directional_quality_breakdown.py"),
        "frozen_files": sources,
        "training_plan": ref(TRIAL / "plan-v1.json"),
        "previous_plan": ref(PREVIOUS / "plan-v2.json"),
        "previous_result": ref(PREVIOUS / "result-v1.json"),
        "previous_audit": ref(PREVIOUS / "audit-v1.json"),
        "methods": [m for mode in MODES for m in plan["methods"][mode].values()],
        "cases": [{"case": item["case"], "geometry": item["geometry"]} for item in old["cases"]],
        "scope": "Exactly the same two V194 native development examples and transported recipe normals; four future saved V195 endpoints. Full-context affine-detrended Fourier-region gains, independently checked using real spatial projectors. Envelope/harmonic/intersection leakage remains; not isolated wire-family amplitudes, independent confidence, population quality or flat safety. No neural work, target inference features, new noise/source draws or RAW decode. No new large array outputs.",
    }
    prepared["inputs"] = [
        prepared[k] for k in ["training_plan", "previous_plan", "previous_result", "previous_audit"]
    ]
    prepared["inputs"] += [item["case"]["arrays"] for item in prepared["cases"]]
    save(ROOT / "plan-v1.json", prepared)
    print("Prepared same two fixed directional examples / four saved endpoints")


def run():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan, __file__)
    scores = read(TRIAL / "scores-v1.json")
    assert not owner_live(scores["owner"])
    assert scores["status"] == "completed-V195-four-endpoint-quality-awaiting-native-viewing"
    assert read(TRIAL / "quality-audit-v1.json")["status"].startswith("pass-V195-four-endpoint")
    (ROOT / "run.claim").open("x").close()
    score_rows = {(r["id"], r["method"]): r for r in scores["rows"]}
    rows = []
    maximum = 0.0
    for item in plan["cases"]:
        case, geometry = item["case"], item["geometry"]
        with np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as arrays:
            present, empty = [
                arrays[k][0].astype(np.float64) for k in ["target_present", "target_empty"]
            ]
        angles = geometry["native_normals_radians"]
        for method in plan["methods"]:
            binding = scores["native_predictions"][case["id"]][method]
            value = load_native(binding)[0].astype(np.float64)
            actual = project(value, present, empty, angles)
            whole, expected = reference(value, present, empty, angles)
            assert abs(actual["whole_template_gain"] - whole) < 2e-12
            assert abs(whole - score_rows[case["id"], method]["template_gain"]) < 2e-12
            for a, b in zip(actual["sectors"], expected, strict=True):
                for key in [
                    "gain",
                    "template_energy_fraction",
                    "template_energy",
                    "projection_numerator",
                ]:
                    np.testing.assert_allclose(a[key], b[key], rtol=2e-8, atol=2e-12)
                maximum = max(maximum, abs(a["gain"] - b["gain"]))
            rows.append(
                {
                    "id": case["id"],
                    "method": method,
                    "prediction": binding,
                    "geometry": geometry,
                    **actual,
                }
            )
            print(
                case["id"],
                method,
                actual["whole_template_gain"],
                [s["gain"] for s in actual["sectors"][:2]],
                flush=True,
            )
    assert len(rows) == 8 and "torch" not in sys.modules
    previous = read(plan["previous_result"]["path"])
    context = [
        row
        for row in previous["rows"]
        if row["method"]
        in [
            "V183-coherent-pair-EMA",
            "V187-pooled-wave-raw",
            "V187-pooled-wave-EMA",
            "V193-large-dense-EMA",
        ]
    ]
    assert len(context) == 8
    save(
        ROOT / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "pass-eight-new-native-directional-projections-independent-spatial-checks",
            "created_unix_UTC": time.time(),
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(TRIAL / "scores-v1.json"),
            "rows": rows,
            "previous_context_rows": context,
            "maximum_region_gain_difference": maximum,
            "sector_scalar_checks": 96,
            "whole_metric_bridges": 8,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
            "Torch_imported": False,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    print("PASS: eight new projections /96 region scalars /eight whole-gain bridges")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["prepare", "run"])
    prepare() if parser.parse_args().phase == "prepare" else run()

watch_directional_response.py.text:
"""One-shot V195 controller: terminal training -> CPU audit -> quality -> native boards."""

import argparse
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from directional_trial_protocol import MODES, REPO, guard, read, ref, save
from directional_trial_protocol import TRIAL as ROOT
from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live


def status(value):
    path = ROOT / "controller-status-v1.json"
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(dict(value, observed_unix_UTC=time.time()), indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def env(work):
    return dict(
        os.environ,
        PYTHONPATH=f"{work}/src:{work}/scripts",
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
        OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
        MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
        CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
    )


def launch():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    assert not (ROOT / "controller-launch-v1.json").exists()
    runner = ROOT / "controller-work-v1.py"
    with runner.open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(Path(__file__).read_text())
    with (ROOT / "controller-v1.log").open("xb") as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"), str(runner), "run"],
            cwd=REPO,
            env=env(plan["work"]),
            stdout=log,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            start_new_session=True,
        )
    owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
    save(
        ROOT / "controller-launch-v1.json",
        {
            "owner": owner,
            "runner": ref(runner),
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "review_source": ref(ROOT / "review-source-v1.json"),
        },
    )
    print(owner)


def run():
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    for _ in range(60):
        try:
            launch_record = read(ROOT / "controller-launch-v1.json")
            assert launch_record["owner"] == owner and launch_record["runner"] == ref(__file__)
            break
        except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            time.sleep(0.2)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing controller launch owner")
    (ROOT / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    try:
        plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
        guard(plan)
        seal = read(ROOT / "review-source-v1.json")
        for name, digest in seal["frozen_files"].items():
            assert ref(name)["sha256"] == digest
        owners = {mode: read(ROOT / f"{mode}-launch-v1.json")["owner"] for mode in MODES}
        while any(owner_live(value) for value in owners.values()):
            for mode in MODES:
                assert not (ROOT / f"{mode}-train-failure-v1.json").exists(), mode
            status(
                {
                    "owner": owner,
                    "status": "waiting-for-original-training-owners",
                    "training_owners": owners,
                }
            )
            time.sleep(2)
        for mode in MODES:
            result = read(ROOT / f"{mode}-train-result-v1.json")
            assert result["owner"] == owners[mode] and result["status"].startswith(
                "completed-V195-"
            )
        children = []

        def stage(name, runner, work, args=()):
            assert not (ROOT / f"{name}-launch-v1.json").exists()
            with (ROOT / f"{name}-v1.log").open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"), runner["path"], *args],
                    cwd=REPO,
                    env=env(work),
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                )
            actual = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            save(ROOT / f"{name}-launch-v1.json", {"owner": actual, "runner": runner})
            status({"owner": owner, "status": "running-" + name, "child_owner": actual})
            while child.poll() is None:
                time.sleep(1)
            assert child.returncode == 0, (name, child.returncode)
            children.append(
                {"name": name, "owner": actual, "runner": runner, "returncode": child.returncode}
            )

        stage("training-audit", plan["auditor"], plan["work"])
